reason: The cyno Ensembl 116 model starts 31 residues upstream of the residue aligned to human Met1, which is an in-frame, native ATG (ortholog Met32). The extension is not in the human protein, carries no signal peptide (DeepTMHMM v1) and would sit on the extracellular N-terminus, where the tag goes. Ensembl 116 has no other model for this cyno gene. Starting at Met32 makes the protein exactly as long as the human reference, which marks the extension as a gene-model error. The repair is a 5' trim to a native codon; no codon is edited. It is an explicit, recorded exception to the ortholog CDS policy's ban on implicit start repairs.
alternative: redraw from the Compara 116 pool (loses the cyno CHRM3 arm); PR 297: next-in-draw replacement from the Compara 116 pool (a different gene)
